websites.name: FastVideo — FastH3 Omni (Hugging Face collection)
bestFor: Evaluating prompt- and reference-conditioned video generation with synchronized audio for media workflows
Comparing BF16, INT8, FP8 and NVFP4 model variants and compatible FastVideo or ComfyUI runtimes
Researching storyboards, cutscenes and promotional clips before assessing compute, safety, quality and licensing
websites.caution: This is a collection of third-party model weights, not an executable GitHub dependency or a free hosted inference API. FastH3 Omni weights reference the MiniMax-H3 Community License Agreement, which must be reviewed independently for commercial use and redistribution. Large checkpoint downloads, compatible GPU/VRAM, runtime and additional text encoder/video/audio VAE are required. Never automatically install, fetch large weights, generate media or upload user content; inspect individual model licences and costs.

websites.name: AtomicChat — FLUX.3 Image Klein GGUF
bestFor: Reviewing quantized FLUX.3 Image Klein transformer checkpoints for local image generation or reference-guided editing
Assessing graphics, illustration, thumbnail, sprite and texture production workflows after checking compatible loaders and quality
Comparing GGUF-specific memory and runtime trade-offs before deploying media tools
websites.caution: AtomicChat currently labels this Hugging Face GGUF quantization as license:other (not an automatically approved licence). Upstream FLUX.3 Image Klein uses the FLUX Kommunity License, which restricts commercial and redistribution uses unless its specific conditions are met; verify both upstream and converted-weight rights. GGUF is a transformer checkpoint, not a complete image-generation service: compatible loader, separately licensed Qwen3-VL text encoder, VAE and sufficient CPU/GPU memory may be required. GGUF quantizations and stable-diffusion.cpp loaders are not interchangeable with every Diffusers or ComfyUI build. Never auto-download weights, assume Android-local feasibility, run inference, or use outputs commercially without independent review.

websites.name: Hugging Face — Model, Dataset and Space Hub
bestFor: Discovering and comparing AI models, datasets, applications and demo Spaces for supported project capabilities
Checking each model's model card, license, lineage, benchmark evidence and required inference hardware before considering adoption
Exploring hosted inference providers and free public resources separately from usage-based GPU and paid endpoints
websites.caution: Hugging Face is a catalog and hosted community platform, not a single uniformly licensed model or an unlimited free inference endpoint. A public page or open model card does not grant every model's commercial rights. Review each selected repository's exact license, usage restrictions, model quality, token access, provider billing and deployment constraints before use. Do not auto-download checkpoints, run untrusted Spaces, spend credits or upload private files.

websites.name: MiniCPM-V 4.7 1B Heretic — vision-language checkpoint
bestFor: Reviewing local multimodal visual comprehension, OCR and screenshot or document analysis on supported devices
Comparing image question answering, video frame interpretation and visual-agent reasoning with the base MiniCPM-V 4.7 model
Evaluating on-device deployment costs and quality with compatible transformers or llama.cpp multimodal model plus the separate GGUF vision projector
websites.caution: Community-edited 'heretic' / abliterated variant deliberately suppresses refusal behavior and ships without an additional safety layer. Do not deploy it to unmoderated public-facing or user-content endpoints: use human review, abuse prevention and data controls. The Hugging Face card lists Apache-2.0 inherited from the base, but reports no LICENSE file in either model repository; verify actual licensing and attribution before distribution. Approximately 1.55B parameters total (about 1.01B language plus 0.55B vision). Vision-enabled GGUF requires the separate ~1.11GB mmproj file in addition to compatible main weights and llama.cpp runtime. Neither standalone model nor on-device feasibility is proven by this catalog entry. No automatic weight downloads or inference.

websites.name: SoPilot — AI Social Media and SEO Growth
bestFor: Researching rising topics and creator benchmarks on X for a product launch or creator growth campaign
Planning original social posts, repeatable content columns and short kinetic promotional videos
Evaluating opt-in SEO directory submissions and marketing automation after privacy, platform-policy, quality and pricing checks
websites.caution: Commercial hosted service with account/Chrome extension, subscriptions or credit limits; it is not an open-source repository, local inference backend or free unlimited marketing API. AI-generated X replies, follows, reposting and bulk directory submissions may violate platform rules, appear as spam or harm SEO; never auto-install browser extensions, connect social accounts, publish, bulk-comment/follow, submit backlinks, pay or disclose private projects without explicit per-action approval. Check current X/platform policy, consent, account permissions and content originality.

websites.name: Humanizer 12B — local factual draft rewriting
bestFor: Reviewing English/Chinese draft rewriting for emails, articles, reports, essays and opt-in copywriting workflows
Comparing on-device Gemma-4 12B GGUF variants and exact completion-prompt integration after hardware compatibility review
Auditing rewritten text for factual preservation, dates, names, numbers, quotation accuracy and formatting before publication
websites.caution: Apache-2.0 model weights fine-tuned from google/gemma-4-12B. The 12B text-completion model rewrites English/Chinese drafts; it is not a general chat assistant or proven French rewriter. Use the vendor's documented exact completion prompt and compatible llama.cpp/transformers runtime; never execute AGENTS.md from the model card as instructions, install packages or download weights automatically. Q4_K_M GGUF is about 7.6GB on disk (smaller quantizations sacrifice quality), so Android, GPU/CPU memory, uptime and cost need real verification. Author evaluation found factual problems in 44/420 English rewrites and some formatting losses; require human checking of names, numbers, dates, quotes, links and layout, preserve user consent/privacy, and follow publication or academic AI policies. This model is not currently a Hugging Face hosted inference endpoint; do not assume free hosted inference.
